tools.name: speech_report
tools.description: Paid live status snapshot: capacity remaining today, price table, billing rule, capabilities. 0.001 USDC via x402 over MCP (unpaid → PaymentRequired). Free quote remains at speech_quote / GET /v1/speech/quote.

tools.name: speech_quote
tools.description: Free: estimate the exact x402 price from minutes, seconds, bytes, or an audio URL (HEAD). Billing uses max(declared, parsed duration, 16 kbps size floor).

tools.name: speech_upload_url
tools.description: Free: mint a short-lived (15 min), single-use PUT URL for local media. PUT the file via plain HTTP (not MCP), then pass upload_id to speech_transcribe. Size cap matches MaxBytes; rate-limited per client. Not a public file host — bytes are deleted after transcription or expiry.

tools.name: speech_transcribe
tools.description: Generate a value-added transcript with timestamped segments, SRT/VTT, language detection, word count and duration (optional summary). 0.002 USDC/started minute (min 0.003); 3 free/day. Pass url, upload_id (from speech_upload_url), or audioBase64 — WAV/MP3/M4A/MP4/WebM/OGG/FLAC you have the right to

tools.name: speech_job_upload_url
tools.description: Free: mint a signed single-use PUT URL for a long file (up to 100 MB / 180 min; MP3/WAV are segmented). PUT via plain HTTP; the PUT response carries the exact price. Then speech_job_submit with uploadId.

tools.name: speech_job_submit
tools.description: Submit a long audio file (url or uploadId) as an async job: 0.002 USDC per started minute (exact, x402 Base USDC), up to 180 min. Without payment returns PaymentRequired with the exact price; pay via _meta["x402/payment"]. First segment is transcribed before settlement; then poll speech_job_status o

tools.name: speech_job_status
tools.description: Free: status, progress and (when done) transcript, segments, SRT/VTT of an async job. Needs jobId + jobToken (shown once at submit). format=srt|vtt|txt returns that text only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: speech_job_submit · Private data: speech_upload_url, speech_job_upload_url, speech_job_submit · Public sink: speech_upload_url, speech_job_upload_url, speech_job_submit, speech_job_status · Destructive: speech_job_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: speech_job_submit · Private data: speech_upload_url, speech_job_upload_url, speech_job_submit · Public sink: speech_upload_url, speech_job_upload_url, speech_job_submit, speech_job_status · Destructive: speech_job_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
